test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Where was the 56th National Cross Country Championships 2022 held?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nagaland__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nagaland**__ will be hosting the **56th National Cross Country Championship in 2022.**
 
• It will be the **first-ever** for the state to host a National Athletics event.
 
• The **55th National Cross Country Championship** was held in February 2021 and was hosted by **Chandigarh Athletics Association.**
 
• It is organized by the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **About Athletics Federation of India (AFI):**

 
 
• Founded - 1946
 
• Headquarters - New Delhi
 
 
 
• **Nagaland**:
 
 
• Capital - Kohima
 
• State Animal - Gayal
 
• State Bird - Blyth's tragopan
 
• State Tree - Alnus nepalensis
